thread:
sophia: Quick alert: onboarding ember-lite-14b (int4) canary showing sporadic OOMs when users ask for long completions (>600).

leo: What config and logs?

sophia: runtime: inference-rt v2.4.0; snippet: ```
E alloc failed: need 384MB for new_token_buf
E kv_eviction: slots=3 slab_jitter=0.67
E request: seq_in=720 max_new=1024 batch=9
```

tara: similar to past fragile int4 cases. Two quick levers: reduce default max_new_tokens and raise slot_reserve.

sophia: I tried slot_reserve 0.15 and soft_evict=true on a subset; eviction rate halved for 10m test.

leo: Also add small_batch_fallback and kv_prefetch_grace_ms=100 to avoid aggressive prefetch.

sophia: Pushed canary update: {model: ember-lite-14b-int4, defaults: max_new_tokens:256, slot_reserve:0.15, soft_evict:true, small_batch_fallback:true, kv_prefetch_grace_ms:100} and started synthetic replay.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied canary config to pool (change 5601).

sophia: 20m in: no OOMs, slab_jitter down to 0.21, tail latency still slightly higher for >600 but stable.

tara: Good. Capture heap + kv profiles and update onboarding checklist to include conservative max_new for int4.

leo: Agreed. Recommend opt-in isolation for customers needing big max_new_tokens.

sophia: Uploading logs + profiles to ticket. Will monitor 24h. :thumbsup:
